episodes.title: Forced Into Marriage: Cult Sister Speaks Out on 11 Hours of Crying
episodes.description:
What happens when the life you were raised to believe in becomes the life you need to escape?

Former FLDS wives Shandra and Marona Johnson join First & Feral to share their experiences growing up in the FLDS community, navigating forced marriage, and living under the control of self-proclaimed prophet Samuel Bateman.

In this emotional conversation, Shandra and Marona open up about the rules they were expected to follow, the challenges of questioning everything they had been taught, and what ultimately led them to leave.

Their stories offer a firsthand look into life inside the Short Creek community and the reality behind the Netflix documentary Trust Me: The False Prophet.

🎙️ This is an extended clip from Shandra and Marona Johnson's full conversation with First & Feral: Utah Unfiltered.

episodes.title: FIRST & FERAL x TOLGA KATAS & CHRISTINE MARIE: Inside Netflix's Trust Me: The False Prophet
episodes.description:
Netflix's The False Prophet EXPOSED | Christine Marie & Tolga Katas Reveal the Story Behind Samuel Bateman

What was it really like to go undercover and help expose one of the most disturbing cult leaders in recent history?

This week on **First & Feral**, we're joined by **Christine Marie** and **Tolga Katas**, the real-life heroes behind Netflix's powerful documentary **The False Prophet**. Christine dedicated years of her life to helping families in Short Creek through her nonprofit, while Tolga documented the journey that ultimately helped expose **Samuel Bateman** and bring his crimes to light.

Together, they share what **wasn't shown on Netflix**, the emotional toll of working alongside victims, the terrifying moments they feared their cover had been blown, and how crucial video evidence became in helping law enforcement build the case.

If you've watched Netflix's *The False Prophet*, this conversation gives you an even deeper look into the true story behind the documentary.

In this episode:

* The real story behind Netflix's *The False Prophet*
* How Christine Marie first became involved in Short Creek
* The years-long investigation into Samuel Bateman
* Going undercover inside a dangerous religious cult
* The emotional impact of helping survivors
* Behind-the-scenes stories that never made the documentary
* How the FBI built the case against Samuel Bateman
* The reality of documenting life inside a fundamentalist community
* Why recording evidence became critical to bringing justice

Whether you're fascinated by **true crime**, **cult documentaries**, **Netflix documentaries**, or stories about resilience and justice, this is an episode you won't want to miss.
